meta.requirement: Explore Dawn Winery (5%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: tip
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Diluc's Hobby
start.text:
''You almost walk past him. He is standing at the edge of the winery's east courtyard with a supply ledger open in one hand, reading it the way someone reads bad news they already knew was coming.''

''He glances up when you approach. Not startled. Just noting.''

Diluc: The kitchen has been closed for the past week. Restocking. ''closes the ledger'' The supplier we usually rely on fell through.

''He looks back at the winery. Something about the set of his shoulders suggests this is not the first problem this week and probably will not be the last.''

Diluc: We are behind on the daily store as well. The cellar team has been too short-handed to sort the regular stock.

''A pause. He evaluates you with the same quiet efficiency he applied to the ledger.''

Diluc: You look like someone who moves around. ''not unkindly'' If you have the time, there are a few things I need.

What_do_you_need.text:
Diluc: Five portions of Perfect Chicken Mushroom Skewer. I want to test them against the current menu before we reopen. ''taps the ledger'' And twenty Sweet Flowers. I have been working on a new infusion. The formula is close, but I need the volume to calibrate the ratio properly.

''He says this as if calibrating a wine infusion is ordinary work, which for him it apparently is.''

Diluc: If you can bring those, I can open the kitchen and the store. ''direct'' That is all I am asking.

I_will_get_them.text:
Diluc: ''already returning to the ledger'' I will be here.

''He does not say thank you. He does not need to. There is something in the way he goes back to work that reads, without question, as trust.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring Diluc 5x Perfect Chicken Mushroom Skewer and 20x Sweet Flower at Dawn Winery

continues.label: Do /rpg and click Deliver to Diluc

deliver.text:
''Diluc looks up from a row of empty infusion bottles he has been lining up on the courtyard table.''

Diluc: Back. ''level, neither impatient nor surprised''

choices.label: Here. 5 Perfect Chicken Mushroom Skewer and 20 Sweet Flowers

wprking_on_it.text:
Diluc: ''nods once, no impatience in it'' Take your time.

''He goes back to the bottles.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring Diluc 5x Perfect Chicken Mushroom Skewer and 20x Sweet Flower at Dawn Winery

winery_open.title: Winery Opened
winery_open.text:
''Diluc sets the infusion bottles aside and takes the skewers first. He does not just look at them. He cuts one in half, checks the interior layer, examines the surface char. He nods once, slowly.''

Diluc: These are good. ''sets them down with care, as if they have earned it''

''He opens the flower bundle. Rolls a petal between his fingers, holds it briefly to his nose.''

Diluc: This will work. ''a short pause, then, straightforwardly'' Thank you.

''He puts the ledger away. Picks up his keys from the courtyard table.''

Diluc: The kitchen opens tonight. The store stock will be sorted by morning. ''a brief, level glance'' You should come by when it does.

''He walks back toward the winery without further ceremony. The keys disappear into his coat. Somewhere inside, a door unlocks.''
